turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so start with who decided to put a zero in the gradebook before anyone picked up a phone and called me.
"Heard my points." I asked you one question, Hale, and I'm writing down that you haven't answered it.
With respect, this is exactly what lawyers do. Make noise until the facts go away.
Facts don't go away when someone asks for them, Hale. Put them on the table, with dates, or I'm in the principal's office at 4:40 instead of on my call.
Your son cheated, and you're teaching him that Mom can make it disappear.
My son does not lie, and I'm writing down that you just called him a cheater with nothing in front of you. Are you calling me a liar too, Hale?
